segments.name: Supply Chain Financing and Trading
segments.description: Supply-chain financing and commodity trading in China for coal, aluminum ingots, sand and steel; scaled down since late 2025.
segments.evidence: However, due to the continuous decline in coal prices and weakening market demand in China, we have significantly scaled down our supply chain financing and trading business segment since late 2025.

segments.name: Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG)
segments.description: Fast-moving consumer goods operations, started in the last quarter of 2024.
segments.evidence: During the last quarter of fiscal year 2024, the Company commenced operations in the Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) sector.

segments.name: Trading Commission and Consulting services
segments.description: Hong Kong brokerage, IPO underwriting and bond issuance, plus business and financial consulting for customers.
segments.evidence: FTFT International Securities and Futures Limited, a company we acquired in November 2023, provides brokerage and investment banking services in Hong Kong.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for brokerage, consulting and trading services; the company earns agent fees or sales margin on coal, aluminum ingots, sand and steel.
revenueModel.evidence: We also provide trading service as we don't take control over the ownership of the goods but receive an agent service fee for the transaction.

changes.text: Supply chain financing and trading was significantly scaled down in 2025.
changes.evidence: However, due to the continuous decline in coal prices and weakening market demand in China, we have significantly scaled down our supply chain financing and trading business segment since late 2025.

changes.text: The Hong Kong asset management business was sold in 2024.
changes.evidence: In November 2024, the Company closed the sale of its remaining 42.86% ownership of NTAM to a third party for HK$2.4 million and is no longer in asset management business in Hong Kong.

changes.text: Fast-Moving Consumer Goods operations began in the last quarter of 2024.
changes.evidence: During the last quarter of fiscal year 2024, the Company commenced operations in the Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) sector.
